title: FailSafe: Reasoning and Recovery from Failures in Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: FailSafe：视觉—语言—动作模型的故障推理与恢复
abstract: Recent advances in robotic manipulation have integrated low-level robotic control into Vision-Language Models, extending them into Vision-Language-Action models. Although state-of-the-art VLAs achieve strong performance, they still inevitably encounter failures during execution. Existing manipulation datasets primarily provide ground-truth trajectories, and failure-detection datasets often offer only textual explanations. FailSafe is a failure generation and recovery system that automatically produces diverse failure cases paired with executable recovery actions. It can be adapted to manipulation tasks in simulators with motion-planning support, enabling scalable creation of failure-action data. The authors fine-tune LLaVA-OneVision-7B to build FailSafe-VLM. It improves Pi-0-FAST, OpenVLA, and OpenVLA-OFT by up to 22.6% on average across ManiSkill tasks and generalizes across spatial configurations, camera viewpoints, objects, and robot embodiments.
